{{dynamic list}}

This is a dynamic list of persons who have made ''major'' contributions to the (mainstream) development of [[general relativity]], as acknowledged by standard texts on the subject.  Some related lists are mentioned at the bottom of the page.
<!---{{Compact ToC|side=yes|top=yes|num=yes}}--->

==A==
* [[Peter C. Aichelburg]] ([[Aichelburg–Sexl ultraboost]], generalized symmetries),
* [[Miguel Alcubierre]] ([[numerical relativity]], [[Alcubierre drive|Alcubierre drives]]),
* [[Richard Arnowitt|Richard L. Arnowitt]] ([[ADM formalism]]),
* [[Abhay Ashtekar]] ([[Ashtekar variables]], dynamical horizons)

==B==
[[File:JamesMBardeen1980.jpg|thumb|216x216px|James M. Bardeen]]
* [[Robert M L Baker, Jr.]] (high-frequency [[gravitational wave]]s),
* [[James M. Bardeen]] (Bardeen vacuum, [[black hole mechanics]], [[gauge theory|gauge-invariant]] linear perturbations of [[Friedmann–Lemaître–Robertson–Walker metric|Friedmann-Lemaître cosmologies]]),
* [[Barry Barish]] ([[LIGO]] builder, gravitational-waves observation),
* [[Robert Bartnik]] (existence of [[ADM mas]]s for [[asymptotically flat spacetime|asymptotically flat vacuums]], [[quasilocal mass]]),
* [[Jacob Bekenstein]] ([[black hole entropy]]),
* [[Vladimir A. Belinsky]] ([[BKL conjecture]], [[inverse scattering transform]] solution generating methods),
* [[Peter G. Bergmann]] (constrained Hamiltonian dynamics),
* [[Bruno Bertotti]] (Bertotti–Robinson electrovacuum, [[Post-Minkowskian expansion|post-Minskowskian expansions]]),
* [[Jiří Bičák]] ([[exact solutions of the Einstein field equations]]),
* [[Heinz Billing]] (prototype of laser [[interferometric]] gravitational-wave detector),
* [[George David Birkhoff]] ([[Birkhoff's theorem (relativity)|Birkhoff's theorem]]),
* [[Hermann Bondi]] (gravitational radiation, Bondi radiation chart, [[Bondi mass|Bondi mass–energy–momentum]], [[LTB dust]], maverick models),
* [[William B. Bonnor]] ([[Bonnor beam]] solution),
* Robert H. Boyer ([[Boyer–Lindquist coordinates]]),
* [[Vladimir Braginsky]] (gravitational-wave detector, [[quantum nondemolition measurement|quantum nondemolition (QND) measurement]])
* [[Carl H. Brans]] ([[Brans–Dicke theory]]),
* [[Hubert Bray]] ([[Riemannian Penrose inequality]]),
* [[Hans Adolph Buchdahl]] (Buchdahl fluid, [[Buchdahl's theorem|Buchdahl theorem]]),
* [[Claudio Bunster]] ([[BTZ black hole]], Surface terms in [[Hamiltonian mechanics|Hamiltonian formulation]]),
* [[Alessandra Buonanno]] ([[effective one-body formalism]]),
* [[William L. Burke]] (Burke potential, textbook)

==C==
[[File:Yvonne Choquet 1974 (photo B; re-scanned B, de-bordered) (cropped).jpg|thumb|Yvonne Choquet-Bruhat|209x209px]]
* [[Bernard Carr]] ([[self-similarity]] hypothesis, [[primordial black holes]]),
* [[Brandon Carter]] ([[no-hair theorem]], [[Carter constant]], black-hole mechanics, [[variational principle]] for Ernst vacuums),
* [[Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar]] ([[Chandrasekhar limit]], colliding [[plane wave]]s, [[quasinormal mode]]s, [[relativistic star]]s, monograph<ref group="note">''The Mathematical Theory of Black Holes''.</ref>),
* [[Jean Chazy]] (Chazy-Curzon vacuum),
* [[Yvonne Choquet-Bruhat]] (formerly Yvonne Bruhat; local existence and uniqueness of solutions to the vacuum Einstein equations, [[initial value formulation (general relativity)|initial value formulations]], textbook),
* [[Demetrios Christodoulou]] ([[naked singularity]] in [[LTB dust]], stability of [[Minkowski space|Minkowski vacuum]]),
* [[Orest Khvolson|Orest Chwolson]] ([[Gravitational lens|gravitational lensing]]),
* [[Alejandro Corichi]] (fundamental contributions to quantum gravity and loop quantum gravity)

==D==

[[File:StanleyDeser2009 01.jpg|thumb|180x180px|Stanley Deser]]
* [[Thibault Damour]] ([[effective one-body formalism]]),
* [[Georges Darmois]] (matching conditions, Darmois vacuum),
* [[Stanley Deser]] ([[ADM formalism|ADM]] initial value formulation, [[effective field theory]]),
* [[Bryce DeWitt]] ([[Wheeler–DeWitt equation]]),
* [[Robert H. Dicke]] ([[Brans–Dicke theory]], [[parametrized post-Newtonian formalism|parametrized post-Newtonian (PPN) formalism]], [[cosmic background radiation|background radiation]]),
* [[Paul A.M. Dirac]] ([[graviton]], monograph),
* [[Tevian Dray]] (asymptotic structure, gravitational shock waves),
* [[Ronald Drever]] ([[LIGO]], [[gravitational-wave detector]]s and observation)

<br />
==E==
[[File:Arthur Stanley Eddington.jpg|thumb|230x230px|Arthur Stanley Eddington]]
* [[Arthur Stanley Eddington]] (early treatises,<ref group="note">''Mathematical Theory of Relativity'' and ''Internal Constitution of the Stars''.</ref> [[relativistic star]]s, [[Eddington–Finkelstein coordinates]], role of [[spacetime curvature|curvature]], [[Post-Newtonian expansion|post-Newtonian expansions]], [[Tests of general relativity|early tests]] and popularization of general relativity),
* [[Jürgen Ehlers]] (Ehlers vacuum family, symmetries of [[PP-wave spacetime|pp wave]]s, spacetime view of [[gravitational lensing]], [[Newtonian limit]]),
* [[Albert Einstein]] (creator of general relativity, [[Equivalence principle|principle of equivalence]], [[Einstein field equations]], [[gravitational time dilation]], [[gravitational redshift]], [[Gravitational lens|gravitational lensing]], [[gravitational wave|gravitational waves]], [[Apsidal precession|perihelion of Mercury]], [[cosmological constant]], [[Einstein–Infeld–Hoffmann equations]], [[Wormhole|Einstein–Rosen bridge]]),
* [[George F. R. Ellis]] (relativistic cosmological models, classification of [[Gravitational singularity#Curvature|curvature singularities]], averaging problem in cosmology, [[gauge theory|gauge-invariant]] linear perturbations of [[spatial heterogeny|spatially homogeneous]] cosmologies, "small universes," [[The Large Scale Structure of Space-Time|monograph]], [[Virbhadra–Ellis lens equation]]),
* [[Frederick J. Ernst]] (Ernst vacuum family, [[Ernst equation]], solution generating methods, Ernst–Wild electrovacuum),
* [[Loránd Eötvös]] ([[Eötvös experiment]])

==F==
[[File:Enrico Fermi giovane.jpg|thumb|251x251px|Enrico Fermi]]
* [[Enrico Fermi]] ([[Fermi coordinates]], [[Fermi–Walker transport]]),
* [[Richard Feynman]] ([[sticky bead argument]] [as 'Mr. Smith'], [[supermassive star]]s, derivation of the Einstein field equations from quantum field theory, Feynman Lectures on Gravitation),
* [[David Finkelstein]] ([[Eddington–Finkelstein coordinates]]),
* [[Vladimir Aleksandrovich Fock]] (textbook, [[Harmonic coordinate condition|harmonic coordinates]]),
* [[Robert L. Forward]] (gravitational-wave detectors),
* [[William A. Fowler]] ([[relativistic star|relativistic stellar models]], [[gravitational collapse]]),
* [[Alexander Friedmann]] ([[Friedmann equations|Friedmann cosmological models]])

==G==
* [[Robert P. Geroch]] ([[Geroch group]], [[singularity theorem]]s, [[GHP formalism]]),
* [[Kurt Gödel]] ([[Gödel dust|Gödel dust solution]], [[closed timelike curve]]s),
* [[Robert H. Gowdy]] ([[Gowdy solution]]s),
* [[Marcel Grossmann]] (taught Einstein the necessary mathematical tools for general relativity),
* [[Allvar Gullstrand]] ([[Gullstrand–Painlevé coordinates]])

==H==
[[File:Stephen Hawking.StarChild.jpg|thumb|230x230px|Stephen Hawking]]
* [[Yusuke Hagihara]] ([[Schwarzschild geodesics]]),
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20210418075401/https://staff.emu.edu.tr/mustafahalilsoy/tr Mustafa Halilsoy] Nutku-Halil solution for colliding waves, [https://royalsocietypublishing.org/doi/10.1098/rspa.1984.0108 On the Nutku—Halil solution for colliding impulsive gravitational waves]
* [[James Hartle]] ([[quantum cosmology]], textbook),
* [[Stephen Hawking]] ([[Penrose–Hawking singularity theorems|Hawking-Penrose singularity theorems]], [[Hawking radiation]], [[Black hole thermodynamics|black-hole thermodynamics]], [[The Large Scale Structure of Space-Time|monograph]], [[Gibbons–Hawking–York boundary term|Gibbons-Hawking-York boundary term]]),
* [[Charles W. Hellaby]] ([[cosmological models]]),
* [[David Hilbert]] ([[Einstein–Hilbert action|Hilbert's action principle]]),
* [[Banesh Hoffmann]] ([[Einstein–Infeld–Hoffmann equations|EIH approximation]]),
* [[Fred Hoyle]] ([[steady-state cosmology]]),
* [[Russell Hulse]] ([[Hulse–Taylor binary|Hulse–Taylor pulsar]])

==I==
* [[Leopold Infeld]] ([[Einstein–Infeld–Hoffmann equations]]),
* [[Richard A. Isaacson]] (energy–momentum complex),
* [[James A. Isenberg]] ([[initial value formulation (general relativity)|initial value formulations]], gluing construction),
* [[Werner Israel]] ([[no-hair theorem]], [[tidal force]]s around black hole [[gravitational singularity|singularities]], [[black hole#internal geometry|black hole interiors]] and [[mass inflation]])

==J==
* [[Theodore Jacobson]] (thermodynamic derivation of Einstein's field equation),
* [[Jørg Tofte Jebsen]] ([[Birkhoff's theorem (relativity)|Birkhoff's theorem]]),
* [[George Barker Jeffery]] (Baldwin–Jeffery [[plane wave]]),
* [[Pascual Jordan]] ([[Brans–Dicke theory|Jordan–Brans–Dicke theory]])

==K==
[[File:Roy Kerr CNZM (cropped).jpg|thumb|225x225px|Roy Patrick Kerr]]
* [[Niky Kamran]] ([[wave equation]]s in black hole space-times),
* [[Ronald Kantowski]] ([[Kantowski-Sachs metric|Kantowski-Sachs fluids]]),
* Anders Karlhede ([[Cartan–Karlhede algorithm|Cartan–Karlhede classification]]),
* [[Edward Kasner]] ([[Kasner metric|Kasner dust solution]]),
* [[Roy Kerr|Roy Patrick Kerr]] ([[Kerr vacuum]], [[Kerr–Schild perturbations|Kerr–Schild metrics]], use of [[Lie group|Lie groups]] in relativity, Kerr–Farnsworth ansatz),
* [[Isaak Markovich Khalatnikov]] ([[BKL singularity|BKL conjecture]]),
* [[William Morris Kinnersley]] ([[photon rocket]]),
* [[Sergiu Klainerman]] (global stability of [[Minkowski spacetime|Minkowski vacuum]]),
* [[Oskar Klein]] (Klein fluid, [[Kaluza–Klein theory|Kaluza–Klein theories]]),
* [[Arthur Komar]] (Komar energy–momentum integrals),
* [[Erich Kretschmann]] ([[Kretschmann invariant]]),
* [[Martin Kruskal]] ([[Kruskal–Szekeres coordinates]] for [[Schwarzschild vacuum]]),
* [[Wolfgang Kundt]] (EK classification of symmetries of [[Pp-wave spacetime|pp waves]])

==L==
[[File:Landau.jpg|thumb|255x255px|Lev Landau]]
* [[Cornelius Lanczos]] ([[Lanczos tensor]], [[van Stockum dust|Lanczos–van Stockum dust]]),
* [[Lev D. Landau]] ([[Landau-Lifschitz pseudotensor|Landau–Lifshitz formulation]], textbook<ref name=":0" group="note">See ''Course on Theoretical Physics'', [[Course of Theoretical Physics#Volume 2|Volume 2]].</ref>),

* [[Evgeny M. Lifshitz]] ([[Stress–energy–momentum pseudotensor#Landau–Lifshitz pseudotensor|Landau–Lifschitz gravitational energy–momentum complex]], [[BKL singularity|BKL conjecture]], textbook<ref name=":0" group="note" />),
* [[Alan P. Lightman]] (problem book),
* [[Casey Lilly]] (gravitational wave theory in general relativity)
* [[Hendrik Lorentz]] ([[Hamilton's principle]], [[coordinate-free]] formulation),
* [[David Lovelock]] ([[Lovelock theory of gravity|Lovelock theory]], [[Lovelock's theorem]])

==M==
[[File:Hermann Minkowski Portrait.jpg|thumb|242x242px|Hermann Minkowski]]
* [[Donald Marolf]] ([[black hole firewall paradox]], [[shock singularity]])
* [[Raymond McLenaghan|R. G. McLenaghan]] ([[Carminati–McLenaghan invariants|CM invariants]]),
* [[Reinhard Meinel]] (Neugebauer–Meinel dust disk solution),
* [[Hermann Minkowski]] ([[Minkowski space|Minkowski spacetime]]),
* [[Charles W. Misner]] ([[Mixmaster universe|mixmaster model]], [[ADM formalism|ADM]] initial value formulation, ADM mass, [[Gravitation (book)|textbook]])
* [[John Moffat (physicist)|John Moffat]] (various classical gravitation theories)
* [[Vincent Moncrief]] (global properties of spatially compact dynamical vacuum spacetimes),

* [[Moustafa Mosharafa]] (relation of radiation, mass and energy)

==N==

[[File:Roger Penrose, 1978 Sept (portion C).jpg|thumb|224x224px|Roger Penrose]]

* [[Roger Penrose]] ([[Hawking–Penrose singularity theorems]], [[Penrose diagram|Penrose diagrams]], techniques from [[algebraic geometry]] and [[differential topology]], [[Penrose limit]]s, [[cosmic censorship hypotheses]], [[Penrose inequalities]], geometry of gravitational [[plane wave]]s, [[impulsive wave]]s, Penrose–Khan colliding plane wave, [[Newman–Penrose formalism]], [[Weyl curvature hypothesis]], highly influential monograph<ref group="note">''Techniques of Differential Topology in Relativity''.</ref>),
